profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Building the future of digital media with AI-driven product development. Senior Product Development Engineer specializing in web development, backend infrastructure, and NLP. More than 10 years of experience in crafting innovative, patented systems and user-facing applications for Fortune 500 enterprises.

🚀 Specialties: Product Development, System Design, AI/NLP Integration
💻 Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, Python
🔧 Backend: Spring, MongoDB, Node.js, TorchServe
🎨 Frontend: React, Redux, React Native, Expo
☁️ Cloud: AWS, S3, Google Cloud Platform
🧠 AI/ML: PyTorch, SpaCy, BERT, GPT, LLaMa
🛠️ Other: Docker, Kubernetes, FFmpeg, Tomcat

positions.title: Senior Product Development Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborate with CTO to design, implement and maintain end-to-end AllStream multimedia and engagement service used by more than 150 brands, world-class media and Fortune 500 enterprises, serving millions of impressions daily.

Lead the development of an Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) system hosted on Amazon EC2.  System trains and deploys a fine-tuned BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) AI model that achieves state-of-the-art performance on targeted sentiment analysis tasks (consistently reaching around 85% accuracy on unseen test dataset and standard benchmarks such as SemEval).  Inference provided by the system is 32% more accurate and 255% faster and operates at nearly 1/10 the cost compared to other leading cloud-based solutions.

Responsible for maintenance of server infrastructure powered by Java, Tomcat, Spring, MongoDB, serving rich-media creatives built using Javascript, HTML, and CSS. System leverages multitude of third-party software and services such as Node.js, Amazon S3, Google Cloud Platform, CloudFlare, FFmpeg, among others.

Provide substantial research and development consultation for 25+ major company projects, including the modernization of the primary ad serving engine, customer-facing system for semantic analysis of uploaded audio / video demand and publisher content, deployment of deep learning models for complex Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks.

Directed the migration to regression-based matching algorithm between media and publisher content, increasing R-Squared engagement correlation from 0.03 to 0.44.

Mentor team of three front-end developers, interviewing candidates, providing code reviews, troubleshooting, and general guidance to ensure code quality and meet project deadlines.
positions.insights: Software Development, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +11 skills

positions.title: Product Development Engineer
positions.description:
Served as key member of engineering department's agile Alpha Team, whose primary responsibilities included maintenance of core legacy creative engine, development of new features and products, regression testing during server upgrades, client technical support, in addition to the development of cutting-edge audio and video experiences.

Prototyped, developed and integrated a client-side frame player and back-end system which converts video demand on-the-fly into content targeted for innovative mobile web creatives, including auto-playing virtual reality video.

Created, tested, debugged and maintained numerous rich-media ad products developed in Javascript, HTML, and CSS. Designed, optimized, and produced new creative formats that increased user engagement.

positions.locationName: New York, New York - 12th Congressional District
positions.description:
Furthered grassroots effort to collect signatures from constituents of the 12th Congressional District for nominating petition. 

Recognized for “leadership and willingness to go the extra mile” throughout contribution to campaign.

Engaged numerous voters in policy discussions in support of incumbent.

positions.title: FOIA/Enforcement Intern
positions.description:
Maintained FOIA IMS database using CRUD functionality to handle data entries on pending charges.

Assisted Intake Unit by meeting charging parties, evaluating intake questionnaires, drafting letters, scanning documents, writing summaries of files, and analyzing charges, complaints and rebuttals.

Critically examined and assessed investigation dossiers to redact pre-decisional and confidential information pursuant to exemptions of the Freedom of Information Act.

patents.title: System for dynamic multimedia analysis, matching and decision-making
patents.description: A system and method to dynamically analyze digital media and select multimedia assets or items to render with correlated IP-connected media and apps. Hierarchical Taxonomy, Engagement-based and Neural-based asset matching is rendered with rule-based and Diminishing Perspective decision-making. A user can listen, view and interact with the correlated and rendered material using an input device native to the computing device being used to access the IP-connected media. Embodiments extract features from the digital media. The extracted features are semantically analyzed for an understanding of characteristics associated with the respective features. Topics are extracted from the digital media based on the characteristics. Stored assets are correlated to the extracted topics to select an asset based on characteristics of the extracted topics correlating with the selected asset. The selected asset is rendered with the digital media.
